stem.en: Kabir says: "Plant B got the message through its roots, obviously; plants are all connected underground." Which of the sim's runs settles it?

text.en: The glass-wall run. Roots and soil were shared and the air was sealed, and B did nothing. The air-shared, pots-separated run gave the response. The channel is the air, at least for this signal.
No run settles it; both channels could work.

feedback.en: With the air sealed, nothing happened. If roots carried it, something would have.
The wasp run shows the wasp smells the plume. It says nothing about B's roots.

text.en: Plants cannot signal at all; B was just coincidence.

feedback.en: The sealed-air run and the shared-air run differ every time. That is not coincidence.

explanation.en: Block one channel at a time. The one whose blocking kills the response is the one carrying it. That is how the real experiment was done.
